title: Prospective Known-Destination Challenge Protocol
negative_results: a reveal at or before the commit epoch is temporally retrospective and is refused (SealError)
an opening that does not reproduce the sealed commitment (prediction altered after the truth) is refused; a wrong salt also breaks the commitment
a seen (non-unseen) target cannot be sealed; a target may be sealed only once (no revision)
a retrospective calibration fit remains OPERATOR_HYPOTHESIS and never promotes
a missed challenge stays OPERATOR_HYPOTHESIS; non-positive tolerance and empty salt fail safely

claims.statement: A sealed decode of an unseen target, committed before the truth is revealed and scored within tolerance afterward, is promoted to CALIBRATED_MAPPING (POWER); this is the only path to that class.
Retrospective fits and post-hoc predictions never promote; the commit-before-reveal order is enforced cryptographically and temporally.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic anchors and salts only, no private inputs, no real coordinates
